legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is freely assignable by Assignee, and any such assignment shall be binding upon the parties hereto.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee from and against any and all claims, damages, or expenses arising out of or related to Assignor's breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising out of or related to this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for ensuring that all closing obligations are fulfilled, including but not limited to payment of closing costs and transfer of title.
